subject: Re: MetaPose kickoff — staffing + compute
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Linnea 50% (TL) through June, Maren 40% on the eval harness and data plumbing, Rosa 40% on the inference path and the robotics-rig integration. Small team, but the released checkpoints and data (the metapose.tar bundle) mean reproduction is mostly plumbing, not retraining.

Compute — light: 8 A100s on titan best-effort for fine-tuning experiments and latency profiling. Nothing reservation-worthy this window.

Privacy — the robotics rig records our own staff; Kofi's office says the standard internal-recording consent flow applies, 2-3 week SLA. Filed today so it clears well before the 06-08 pilot.

On your Q3 note: yes, planning for continuation. I'm carrying Linnea forward as the anchor — details when we do Q3 allocations in June, but assume she stays majority-time on MetaPose.

Daniela
